headline: Senate advances landmark college sports protection bill with supermajority cloture vote while House moves on fentanyl and fraud bills!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate rejected a motion to advance the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act in a 49-50 vote, falling short of the 60-vote threshold needed. However, it secured 74 votes to clear a procedural hurdle on the Protect College Sports Act, which will see continued debate on Wednesday morning post-cloture. The chamber also confirmed Matthew R. Byrne as a United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio by a 52-45 vote.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - Protect name, image, and likeness rights of student athletes and promote fair competition in intercollegiate athletics
onTheFloor.status: Cloture invoked 74-24; motion to proceed debate continuing Wednesday

onTheFloor.title: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act - Create federal regulation system for digital commodities and restrict Federal Reserve from offering central bank digital currency products
onTheFloor.status: Cloture motion failed 49-50; motion to reconsider filed

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed multiple bills focused on fraud prevention and drug enforcement, including the GUARD Act targeting elder financial fraud (414-7), the Fentanyl Prevention package including Tyler's Law (424-0), and measures to combat xylazine and counterfeit pill operations. The chamber also passed a War Powers resolution directing removal of U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (220-204) and tabled an impeachment resolution against the former President (232-147).

onTheFloor.title: Guarding Unprotected Aging Retirees from Deception (GUARD) Act - Allow law enforcement to use federal funds for investigating elder and financial fraud
Whistleblower Protection Act - Extend whistleblower protections to contracts funded by HUD appropriations
Tyler's Law - Direct HHS guidance on fentanyl testing in hospital emergency departments for overdose patients
Stop Pills That Kill Act - Prohibit misuse of tableting and encapsulating machines for illicit controlled substance manufacturing
War Powers Resolution - Direct President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran
Impeachment Resolution against former President - Motion to table agreed to 232-147
